description: CELL-A stored-model pilot (PCRL Round-4 Adult seed 0): effective executed recipe settings

units.note: release seeds are release draws over the same people, not populations or encoder seeds

support.pair_rule: a pair is supported iff both classes are supported
support.task_classes: the same 100/30/100 rule selects y_task classes for macro-F1 / per-class utility / utility macro AUC; accuracy and log-loss use all assessment rows (Addendum D1 9f)
support.description: frozen from counts in all three roles before any fit; NE (not estimable) is distinct from UNRESOLVED

N0.label: historical native check: in-sample on the PCRL test split
N0.description: one-hot pooled ridge R2 on the unnormalised centred Gram, fit = score on all test rows, clamped at 0 as historically (raw also stored). historical_mixed_precision = float32 centring and Gram, float64 one-hot, cross-product, solve and R2 (pcrl/purposes/verification.py:89-103 via eval_round4_dominant_axis.py:158-172); float64 = everything in float64. Noise units: unverified (Addendum D1 #7)

N1.label: within-assessment native-form statistic (descriptive; not the historical check)
N1.description: same estimator, fit = score on assessment rows; descriptive only

rho1_heldout.description: canonical directions on attacker_fit; per-row RHO_u = H b and RHO_v = a[y] saved on assessment; squared correlation re-weighted in the bootstrap

pure_metric.description: the G1 one-hot least-squares predictions scored as macro OvR AUC (supported classes), predicted column k = score for class k

GBT.description: HistGradientBoostingClassifier; early stopping on an internal split of attacker_fit

NL.description: one NL-selected predictor per unit/surface; assessment never selects

LRT_A2.description: defense-informed Gaussian class-conditional LRT (R10, access A2): class means and covariances from RELEASED attacker_fit rows, covariance minus sigma^2 I, eigen-floored at eig_floor_rel * trace / d, predictive covariance = floored + sigma^2 I; no clean vectors

LRT_A4.description: white-box population LRT (R09, access A4; labelled stress test): class Gaussians from CLEAN attacker_fit representations plus known Sigma = sigma^2 I

A3_repeated_query.description: under the frozen contract (persistent=True, release_count one) N collapses to 1; a fresh-query contract is a different release interface needing a separate amendment

surfaces.description: noise-unit outputs surface = clean model output, identical across arms; its attackers/predictions are REUSED from outputs_reuse_source and marked reused

LO.description: label-only reference: frequency table P(s | y_task) on attacker_fit

U1.description: the unit purpose's frozen head; no fitting

U2.description: independent LR utility probe on the released representation (LR only)

normalised_lift.description: normalised lift (acc - acc_const)/(acc_clean - acc_const) is reported only when the clean lift point is >= min_clean_lift; otherwise flagged

utility.paired_reference: untreated unit of the same purpose (income_prediction__sex for noise units)

recovery_metrics.LLR_nats: LL0 - LL (nats per row; LL0 = attacker_fit prior)
recovery_metrics.worst_class: max OvR AUC over supported classes
recovery_metrics.worst_pair: max pair AUC over supported pairs, score p_j/(p_i+p_j)

inference.draw: rng = numpy.random.default_rng(seed); replicate b: counts = rng.multinomial(n_units, full(n_units, 1/n_units)); row weight = counts[unit index]; unit order = numpy.unique(assess_unit)

primary.validity_note: percentile-bootstrap bounds are asymptotic, not exact; each endpoint can err in only one direction, so two one-sided bounds at alpha/16 bound the family-wise error by 0.05 (asymptotically)

inference.seed_aggregation: mean over release seeds within each bootstrap replicate (same resampled units)
inference.max_ne_replicate_fraction: alpha of the bound (tail) - more NE replicates make the interval NE

unsupported.R11_adaptive_general: needs stored fitted defense parameters for a learned defense; the noise defense is closed-form and covered by LRT_A2 (closed form) - not run
unsupported.R12_repeated_release: STAGED: persistent contract gives N = 1 (see attackers.A3_repeated_query)
unsupported.R13_knows_basis: subspace channel only; not in CELL-A
unsupported.R14_coalition: multi-purpose scenario not in this pilot
unsupported.R15_insider: not run in the pilot (stress test listed for completeness)
unsupported.R01_C_100: FROZEN_DESIGN fixes L to C in {0.01,0.1,1,10}; methodology value 100 not executed
unsupported.R05_logistic_variant: label-only reference uses the frequency table only (FROZEN_DESIGN)
unsupported.permutation_null: dropped for real units (200 refits per unit exceed the allowance; Addendum D1 9c); synthetic null/positive controls run through the same CLI path instead
unsupported.per_cell_real_controls: dropped (Addendum D1 9d); synthetic controls replace them
unsupported.refit_seed_replicates: single refit seed (random_state 0); refit variance not estimated (Addendum D1 9b)
unsupported.U2_mlp_probe: dropped (Addendum D1 9g); U2 is LR only
unsupported.stratified_role_split: roles are the frozen pilot-roles-v1 hash split (not stratified by s,y)
